recipes.name: Buffalo Pasta Salad
ingredients: ⅓ cup cayenne pepper hot sauce
instructions: Add the pasta to a pot of salted boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, or until al dente.
Meanwhile, mix all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl*.
Chop all the veggies and add them to a large bowl.
Heat the oil in a small pan over medium-high heat. Cook the beans for 3 to 4 minutes, or until lightly golden. This is an optional step.
When cooked, add the drained pasta to the large bowl, along with the cooked beans. Pour over the dressing, toss together, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Also known as lima beans. † We used Frank's Red Hot Sauce. * Note, the dressing packs a lot of heat and tang from the cayenne pepper hot sauce (we used Frank's Hot Sauce). For a less spicy and tangy dressing, start with less and add more to taste.
Storage The salad can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
